summary: Russian strikes on Kyiv and Zaporozhye with Zircon missiles and FABs; Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian logistics and oil facilities; ongoing frontline clashes in Kharkov and Zaporozhye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352) (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70051) (Source: @UkraineNow/83350)
